name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Settings page polish: the tab row stays on one line and scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, the active tab stays in view, buttons and toggles get larger tap targets and clear focus rings on small screens, and the remaining hard-coded blue tints now follow your theme. Browsing a Plex library is much faster: one library fetch is reused while you scroll instead of refetching the whole library for every page. Companion dashboard (also shown in the new Windows app window) gets a cleaner, flatter app layout with solid colours, clearer buttons and form controls, and more readable status badges.
